component.name: PortalItem
component.script: sub onContentChange() m.top.findNode("itemLabel").text = m.top.itemContent.title end sub sub onFocusChange() if m.top.focusPercent > 0.5 m.top.findNode("background").color = "0x7F5AF0FF" else m.top.findNode("background").color = "0x222222FF" end if end sub
